desc: Analyze structure: sort A,B,C descending so f(i,j,k) is monotone non-increasing in each index; set of triples with f>=T is a down-set.
Prove truncation to first M=min(N,K) elements is value-preserving.
Implement best-first heap expansion (unique predecessor, packed int keys, encode code = i*2^36+j*2^18+k).
Reason about complexity: O(N log N) + O(K log K), bounded heap size, edge cases (N=1, K=1, ties, K near N^3).
